evals.prompt: Draw the lineage of a small dbt project as an SVG I can put in a README. Sources: orders, customers and payments, loaded raw. One staging view per source. Marts: dim_customers and fct_payments, plus an aggregate agg_daily_revenue built from fct_payments. I want it to read left to right, with raw, staging, marts and aggregate as columns, and it should be animated. Save it as lineage.svg.
evals.expected_output: A left-to-right lineage SVG with four stage columns, every table listed vertically in its column, straight or merged lines, animated, no crossing cards.

evals.prompt: Create an ERD as SVG for a retail star schema: fct_sales (sale_id, store_key, date_key, product_key, quantity, net_amount) with dim_store, dim_date and dim_product. List the columns inside each table box, one per line, mark primary and foreign keys, and draw the FK lines from the fact to the dimensions. I need a light and a dark version. Save erd-light.svg and erd-dark.svg.
evals.expected_output: Two ERD SVGs, table boxes with vertical column lists and PK/FK markers, FK lines from fact to each dimension without loops, dark version genuinely dark.

evals.prompt: Make an architecture diagram (SVG) of a nightly batch pipeline: an operational Postgres database and a partner S3 bucket with CSV files get loaded by Airflow into Snowflake, dbt builds marts there, and Looker reads the marts. Keep it clear enough for a stakeholder slide. Save it as architecture.svg.
evals.expected_output: A clear left-to-right architecture SVG with all six components, labelled connections, no overlapping boxes or crossing lines.

evals.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram of how our nightly pipeline runs: Airflow triggers an Airbyte sync, Airbyte pulls pages from a CRM API (5 pages) and loads Snowflake raw, then Airflow runs dbt build, which reads raw and writes marts, and finally Airflow refreshes a Looker dashboard. Three phases, numbered calls, as an SVG for a README.
evals.expected_output: A sequence SVG with participant columns, lifelines, activation bars, solid calls and dashed returns, three labelled phases, numbered calls, no clipped labels.

evals.name: dbt-manifest-import
evals.prompt: I have a dbt manifest at {FILE0}. Draw the lineage of everything upstream of fct_orders as an SVG for our wiki, with the models grouped by layer from left to right. Save it as lineage.svg.
evals.expected_output: An SVG with columns by layer (sources, staging, intermediate, marts), only fct_orders and its ancestors (no agg_daily_revenue, no dashboard, no legacy_report), lines between them and no line through a card.

evals.name: layout-instructions-win
evals.prompt: Draw a left to right lineage SVG, one column per layer: raw (orders, customers, payments), staging (stg_orders, stg_customers, stg_payments), marts (dim_customers, fct_orders), aggregates (agg_daily_revenue), dashboards (revenue_dashboard). Each stg_ model reads from its raw table; dim_customers reads stg_customers; fct_orders reads stg_orders, stg_payments and dim_customers; agg_daily_revenue reads fct_orders; the dashboard reads the aggregate. The payments chain MUST be on the top row and the dashboard must be alone in the right-most column. Save it as lineage.svg.
evals.expected_output: payments chain (raw.payments, stg_payments) drawn at a smaller y than the orders and customers chains; revenue_dashboard has the largest x of all cards; valid SVG with arrows.

evals.name: schema-diff
evals.prompt: Here are two versions of our billing schema: {FILE0} (old) and {FILE1} (new). Draw one diagram that shows what changed: tables and columns that were added, removed or changed, each clearly labelled and coloured, with the tables' keys visible. Save it as schema-diff.svg and give me a short list of the changes.
evals.expected_output: One SVG of the schema with ADDED / CHANGED / REMOVED style labels or a legend; refunds table marked added; invoices status column marked removed and paid_at added; plans price type changed and currency added.

evals.name: animated-gif
evals.prompt: Make an animated GIF (not an SVG) for a slide: a pipeline flow from Postgres to an S3 landing bucket to Snowflake raw to dbt marts to a Looker dashboard, with a dot travelling along each connection. Save it as flow.gif.
evals.expected_output: A valid GIF89a file with many frames that loops, showing five stages left to right.

evals.name: brand-colours
evals.prompt: Draw the lineage raw_orders -> stg_orders -> fct_orders -> orders_dashboard as an SVG in our brand look: page background #fdf6ec, cards #fffaf2 with a #d9c7a8 border, text #3b2a14, and connection lines in #0b6e4f. Save it as brand.svg.
evals.expected_output: SVG using the requested colours for background, cards, text and lines, readable, four nodes in a row with arrows.
